title: Topic 19
japanese_text:
A：親の反対を<u>押し切って</u>東京で就活始めたけど、このまま春まで就職先が決まらなかったら、どうしよう。
B：とりあえず<u>非正規</u>で働きながら、就活続けてみたら？卒業後３年以内は<u>新卒</u>として扱ってくれる企業も多いみたいだよ。
A：うーん。今でも毎日へとへとなのに、<u>まして</u>働きながら就活なんて私には無理そう。やっぱりこのタイミングを<u>逃したく</u>ないな。
english_translation: A: Going against my parents' objections, I've started job hunting in Tokyo, but what if I can't find a job by spring? B: Why don't you work part-time while you keep job hunting, just for now? I think most companies will treat you as a new graduate if you're within three years of graduation. A: Hmmm. At the moment, I'm exhausted every day, and I think it'd be even more difficult for me to find a job if I was working. I don't want to miss this opportunity.
